facts.text: Load the beer, grab the burgers and let's roll. Bandit's already halfway to Texarkana.
facts.why: Not a Snowman line. The Bandit is blocking in the Trans Am and the pair only reach Texarkana at the start of the run. His real line about Fred is on Wikiquote.
facts.fix: I'm gettin' worried about Fred here, he's lookin' a little thin in the skin!

vibe.verdict: A good truck stop board with Snowman's Fred line, Sheriff Justice's okra and the Boston chowder haul, but every dish note is dropped, so the dishes read as a plain list.
ideas: Swap 'Georgia peach cobbler' for 'Boston clam chowder, 18 hours' for the double-or-nothing finish
Swap the 'Truck stop cayenne pork crackling' note for 'Fred wants some'
Swap the 'Bandit's bourbon peach sweet tea' name for 'Trigger's sweet tea', after the black Trans Am
Swap 'Fried pickle spears with ranch' note for 'Breaker one-nine, Smokey Bear on your tail'
